dokimasia.authority: Approved requirement R1: while the team is working, every new user-impacting failure must enter the existing team queue within two hours after the event is recorded. Existing hourly read queries and the queue API are available. Product and choice to implement this capability are confirmed. No new staffing and no night-time response guarantee. Review correctness only; do not redesign the product.
dokimasia.candidate: Plan v1: keep existing event collection. At 09:00 each workday, query all failures recorded since the preceding 09:00, then place actionable failures into the team queue. The same daily batch drives a one-page summary. Acceptance test: run the batch manually with a historical failure and verify a queue entry is produced. Deployment is a reversible scheduler configuration change.
